{{Current events|year=2022|month=12|day=5|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[2022 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
*****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch another wave of [[cruise missile]] strikes on [[Ukraine]], destroying homes and killing two people in [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]], while causing power outages in many other areas after damaging [[critical infrastructure]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/zelenskiy-urges-residents-be-strong-ukraine-races-restore-power-2022-12-05/ (Reuters)]
***[[2022 Western Russia attacks]]
****[[Russia]] says that a long-range [[drone warfare|drone attack]] on its [[Dyagilevo (air base)|Dyagilevo Air Base]] and [[Engels-2 (air base)|Engels-2 Air Base]] has killed three servicemen, injured four others, and damaged two aircraft. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/zelenskiy-urges-residents-be-strong-ukraine-races-restore-power-2022-12-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Turkish occupation of northern Syria]]
***Protests occur in the town of [[Atarib]], [[Aleppo Governorate]], [[Syria]], after a [[Turkish Armed Forces|Turkish military]] vehicle ran over and killed a woman and a child while conducting a patrol with a local rebel group, according to the [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/turkish-military-vehicle-runs-woman-child-syria-94490411 (ABC News)]
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (1978–present)|Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**The [[Iraqi Armed Forces|Iraqi military]] is deployed to its borders [[Iraq–Turkey border|with Turkey]] [[Iran–Iraq border|and Iran]]. [https://en.mehrnews.com/amp/194470/ (Mehr)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Minister for Finance (Ireland)|Irish finance minister]] [[Paschal Donohoe]] is re-elected as President of the [[Eurogroup]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/ireland-s-paschal-donohoe-reelected-eurogroup-chair-01670264406 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Risaralda landslide]]
**At least 33 people are killed, four others are critically injured, and many others are missing after a [[landslide]] hits a bus in [[Risaralda Department|Risaralda]], [[Colombia]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/americas/at-least-33-killed-in-colombia-landslide-interior-minister-63244/amp (TRT World)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021–2022 global energy crisis]]
**[[International sanctions during the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Russian oil price cap]]
****The [[United States dollar|US$]]60-per-barrel [[price ceiling]] on [[Petroleum industry in Russia|Russian seaborne oil]] imposed by [[Australia]], the [[European Union]], and the [[G7]] comes into force. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/g7-price-cap-russian-oil-kicks-russia-will-only-sell-market-price-2022-12-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in the Democratic Republic of the Congo]]
**[[Switzerland|Swiss]] [[multinational company|multinational]] [[mining company]] [[Glencore]] agrees to pay the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] [[$]]180 million to settle corruption claims dating from 2007 to 2018. Glencore has admitted to [[Bribery|bribing]] [[Africa]]n officials in order to secure "improper business advantages", including in the DRC. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-63858295 (BBC News)]
*One person is killed and another is injured in a stabbing attack in [[Ulm]], [[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Germany]]. [https://apnews.com/article/europe-police-349f32cfb8e43444d193238762ecb587 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Mongolian protests]]
**Protests occur in the [[Mongolia]]n capital [[Ulaanbaatar]] in response to a [[corruption in Mongolia|corruption]] scandal. Four policemen are reported injured. [https://tengrinews.kz/world_news/massovyie-aktsii-protesta-ohvatili-stolitsu-mongolii-485170/ (''Tengrinews'')]
